telemetry.dev
evidenceItems.summary: LLM observability for AI agents - telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

GitHub Copilot Fusion
evidenceItems.summary: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models - GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

evidenceItems.title: SpaceO
evidenceItems.summary: Give AI agents their own screen on your Mac - Give AI agents a separate display for real Mac apps while you keep working. Connect through MCP or the CLI, watch sessions in the Viewer, and take over when an agent needs help. Supports native apps and Chromium. Free and MIT licensed; Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. Attention isolation, not a security sandbox: apps run as your macOS user. Runtime support depends on your macOS build.

evidenceItems.title: BaseTab AI
evidenceItems.summary: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace - BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

evidenceItems.title: Agnos

Exports JSONL chunks, cleand text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nohing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days ree, then $99 once.
